# 3 Axial Skyrmions
- The current paper adopts a definition involving a sign change in one pion field, which leads to a relative phase difference of π compared to refs. [3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion is defined by flipping all three pion fields.
- This specific definition is preferred because it facilitates a more straightforward comparison with monopoles.
- The profile function vanishes at a distance of s/2 from the Skyrmion or antiSkyrmion center, allowing the fields to be patched together continuously while maintaining vacuum values outside their respective cores as shown in (3.10).
- Beyond the basic ansatz described in (3.7), the study incorporates more complex initial conditions utilizing the rational map ansatz with an axially symmetric charge n map as discussed in ref. [11].
